sentences.text: REASONS 9. POINT No.1 and 2: For the sake of convenience and to avoid repetition of facts, these points are taken up for common discussion to have brevity.

10. It is the case of the prosecution that, on 01.09.2021 at about 9.25 a.m. the accused being the driver of Honda Activa Scooter bearing registration No.KA-01-JB-0710 drove the same on S.G.Palya Main Road, Next to Gousiya College, in a rash and negligent manner so as to endanger human life and dashed to Pulsar Motorcycle bearing registration No.KA-01-HG-0967.
Due to the impact of accident, the rider of the Pulsar Motorcycle i.e., CW.1 fell down and sustained simple injuries.

Thereby the accused is alleged to have committed the offences punishable U/s.279 and 337 of IPC.
11.
In the instant case, the concerned investigating officer has filed charge sheet against both the persons, who were riding the bike and scooter which met with accident.

The bike rider pleaded guilty and the ride of the scooter contested the case, in order to prove the contents of complaint the prosecution examined 2 witnesses as P.W.1 and P.W.2 and marked 9 documents as Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.9

. 
C.C.No.36/2022 12. C.W.4/Sri Thippaiah is examined as P.W.1 deposed that, on 01.09.2021 at around 09:35 AM, he received information about an accident on Marigowda Road.

Upon reaching the location and beginning our inquiry, we learned that a two-wheeler bearing registration number KA 01 GB 0710,
coming from the Sadduguntepalya side toward Marigowda Road, was attempting to reverse an auto-rickshaw.
At the same time, another two-wheeler bearing registration number KA 01 HG 0967 was traveling from Marigowda Road towards Sadduguntepalya.
A collision occurred between the two vehicles, and both riders fell to the ground.
He immediately approached the spot and helped both individuals sit on the side of the road.
Later, the injured person's father arrived and took him to Sanjay Gandhi Hospital.
The rider who had caused the accident then also said he would go to the hospital and went to Jayanagar General Hospital.
After that, he took both vehicles involved in the accident to the police station.
He has given a statement that the accident occurred due to the fault of Mr. Gopinath Timmappa.

During his cross-examination by accused counsel he deposed that at the time of accident he was discharging duty in dairy circle which is 500 mtrs away from accident spot, he deposed he reached the spot after 10 mins, he admitts other vehicle rider also sustained injuries and he also lodged complaint.
He denied the suggestions of the accused counsel.

sentences.text: C.W.9/Sri Prakash is examined as P.W.2 who is the Investigating Officer of this case.
He deposed that, on 02.09.2021 at around 5:00 PM, while he was on duty as the Station House Officer, CW-1 appeared at the police station and submitted a written complaint.
Based on the complaint, a case was registered under Crime No. 49/2021 for offences punishable under Sections 279 and 337 of the Indian Penal Code.
The case report was forwarded to the Hon'ble Court and the higher authorities.
On 03.09.2021, he visited the accident spot between 9:30 AM and 10:30 AM.
In the presence of CW-2 and CW-3, he conducted the spot mahazar at the location shown by CW-1 and prepared a rough sketch.
On the same day, he recorded the statements of CW-2 to CW-5.
On 06.09.2021, he submitted a requisition letter to the concerned department for the inspection of the vehicles involved in the accident.
On 13.09.2021, a notice under Section 133 of the Motor Vehicles Act was issued to CW-6, and a reply was received.
Based on the reply, the accused was produced, formally arrested, and after following the due procedures and obtaining proper sureties, he was released on station bail.
On 14.09.2021, after the vehicle inspection, he obtained a loss compensation certificate from the owner and released the vehicle.
On 01.10.2021, he received the vehicle inspection report from CW-7.
On 01.11.2021, he obtained the injury certificate of the victim from CW-8.
After reviewing the case file and upon completion of the investigation, he submitted the charge sheet against the accused to the Hon'ble Court.

C.C.No.36/2022 During his cross examination he admits accident spot has high density of traffic and riding vehicle in high speed is not possible during peak hours, he denied the suggestions of accused counsel.
14. Out of the documents marked for prosecution that, Ex.P.1 is the Complaint, Ex.P.2 is the FIR,

Ex.P.3 is the Spot Mahazar, Ex.P.4 is the sketch, Ex.P.5 is the 133 Notice, Ex.P.6 is the Reply for 133 Notice, Ex.P.7 is the IMV Report, Ex.P.8 is the wound certificate and Ex.P.9 is the Indemnity Bond.
15. In the instant case the prosecution has alleged that both vehicle riders were at fault and they submitted charge sheet against both of them in separate cases.
The prosecution alleged that, the accused drove his vehicle in a rash and negligent manner and dashed to complainants vehicle and thereby committed the offences punishable U/s.279 and 338 of IPC.

Section 279 IPC deals with rash and negligent driving of any vehicle or riding on a public way in a rash and negligent manner so as to endanger human life or likely to cause hurt or injury to any person.

In order to constitute an offence U/s.279 of IPC, it must be established that the accused was driving the vehicle on a public way in rash and negligent manner to endanger human life or to likely cause to hurt or injury to any other person.
For the purpose of section 279 rash and negligent may be described as criminal rashness or criminal negligence.
It must be more C.C.No.36/2022 than mere carelessness of error of judgment.

The essential ingredients of section 279 are: (1) rash and negligent driving or riding on a public way, (ii) The act must be such as to endanger human life or likely to cause hurt or injury to any person.

16. Prosecution relied its case on P.W.1 and 2, unfortunately both of them are not eye witness and both of them belongs to investigation team, both of them not seen the accident live ane they visited spot after substantial period, with regard to negligent act on the part of the accused , the prosecution did not examine either complainant, victim or any eye witness.

sentences.text: 17. In the instant case, the prosecution has alleged that, rider of the vehicle is at fault which met with accident,
The burden is upon the prosecution to establish that the accused who is facing the trail committed the rash and negligent act.

The examined witnesses during their cross- examination clearly deposed that, it is busy road with high density of traffic, then the question of high speed loses its importance, they did not examine any single witness who saw the accident who can depose about negligence on the part of the accused.
18. The examined witnesses have not stated rash and negligent act on the part of the accused on the date of alleged C.C.No.36/2022 incident.
Further none of the eye witnesses have not stated the rash and negligent act of the accused to show his involvement.

Therefore, in this circumstance of the case, the case of prosecution regarding rash and negligent act and also regarding involvement of the vehicle of accused facing trial could not be made out beyond reasonable doubt.
19. Therefore, looking to the evidence available on record and the materials placed by way of oral and exhibits, the case of prosecution appears to be doubtful.
There is doubt as to whether the accused had driven the said vehicle in a rash and negligent manner, so as to endanger the human life and personal safety of others.
Therefore, in the circumstances of the case, the prosecution has failed to prove the alleged offence against the accused No.1.
Accordingly, the points under consideration are answered point No.1 and 2 IN THE NEGATIVE.

20. POINT No.3: In view of the above discussions and findings I proceed to pass the following ORDER Acting U/s.255(1) of Criminal Procedure code, the accused is hereby acquitted of the offences alleged against him punishable U/s.279 & 337 of IPC.
C.C.No.36/2022 Bail bonds of accused and surety bonds shall stands cancelled after the appeal period.
